content.content:
Apply by reading the dependent and the prerequisites it names as recorded; there is nothing to run.
1. Licence, once per prerequisite in depends_on. No element of the dependent contradicts a prerequisite it names. Read the dependent clause by clause against each prerequisite; fail on every contradicting element, naming the element and the prerequisite it departs from.
2. Licence, no rule borrowed. No element of the dependent states, as a prerequisite's rule or as following from one, something that prerequisite leaves outside its own scope or defers to another decision. Fail on any such element, naming the element and the prerequisite whose scope it overstates. A rule the prerequisites leave open is the dependent's own answer and is written as the dependent's own: stating it is required, attributing it to a prerequisite is the failure this limb names.
3. Engagement: the dependent itself answers the commit-point question. In its content — not in its rationale, and not by pointing at a prerequisite instead — the dependent must state, as its own answer: (a) that the registry removal is the commit point, taken only after every named draft's change act, workspace act and directory act have completed; (b) that a failure at any point before that commit refuses the invocation; (c) that a failure before that commit removes no record, so every named draft's record stays at its handle. Fail on any limb the dependent leaves unanswered or answers only by reference, naming the missing limb; fail on a limb whose answer contradicts a prerequisite, under criteria 1 and 2.
4. Non-encroachment. The dependent settles nothing the prerequisites leave outside this use: the verb surface — the command, its name, flags, arguments and wording — and the output, refusal wording, stream and exit status, including how a failure of an act or of the removal reaches the user; the exact jj invocations and flags behind the workspace and change acts; the mechanism, atomicity, durability or concurrent-writer behaviour of the registry write; how the change the draft's workspace holds is abandoned; and the record's field set or serialization. Fail on any element that settles one of these, naming the element and the commitment it duplicates.
5. Applicability. The criterion is applied to the decision content the dependent is meant to carry. Fail when the dependent carries none — empty or placeholder content; an absent decision is not a silent pass.

Findings name the offending element or the missing limb. Nothing is named in advance, so rewording the dependent without changing what it decides leaves this criterion intact.
content.rationale:
Every edge here is read, not run. vzposmvm, tvxspkyy, vkkwusty, twpvqstu and kxyznwxu carry prose, so those five edges are the natural-to-natural cell and take its gate form. lnpnkvkv and yomurusp are requirement sentences, so those two edges are the structured-to-natural cell, which has no dedicated entry in the matrix and takes the default — the gate form — and is flagged here for a matrix entry. One evaluation covers all seven edges because they answer one question: which acts of a discard happen before the record leaves, and what a failure before that point leaves standing. A single clause-by-clause pass reads the dependent against the seven at once; splitting would check the same clauses seven times.

Licence is the cell's check: the dependent may narrow what its prerequisites commit but may neither contradict them nor state their scope more widely than they do. The added-rule limb is where the licence actually turns. The commit-point policy — the removal taken last, a failure before it refusing, and no record removed when it does — is not stated by any prerequisite: the workspace half of a discard expressly leaves the failure of its crossings and of the removal outside itself, the removal fixes what the removal takes out and not the order in which it is taken, and the whole-invocation refusal covers a handle that names no open record, not an act that failed. The dependent may therefore add that rule, but only as its own answer; presenting it as stated by, or as following from, a prerequisite would overstate that prerequisite's scope, which is the failure the limb names.

The engagement limb is the use itself. The dependent's job is to say where the commit point sits and what a failure before it leaves standing, so the criterion requires it to say so in its own words rather than deferring to a prerequisite, and requires both halves — the order and the no-removal outcome: an answer with the order but not the outcome, or the outcome but not the order, has not made the use.

The non-encroachment limb keeps the gate from demanding more than the decision: the verb surface, output and exit status (including how a failure reaches the user), the jj invocations, the registry write's mechanism and atomicity, the change's abandonment, and the record's serialization are recorded elsewhere and stay out. The applicability limb makes a placeholder fail rather than pass vacuously. Findings name the element or the missing limb, nothing is named in advance, and the criterion survives rewording the dependent without changing what it decides.
